timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Why can't admins just have permanent access? It's faster right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Faster until their account gets compromised and the attacker has global admin forever.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So PIM fixes that how exactly?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Eligible assignments mean you request the role when needed. It activates for a limited time then expires.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the difference between PIM for Entra roles and Azure resources?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Entra roles control identity management. Azure resource roles control access to subscriptions and resources.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It governs membership of privileged groups. Time-bound membership with approval workflows.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about approvals? Who approves the activation?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: You can require multi-level approvals, business justification, or access packages for governance.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How does this tie into the Enterprise Access Model?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: EAM defines tiering — T0 is most sensitive. PIM enforces controls at each tier.
